rebuttal_or_critique: With headline CPI at 7.01% and core inflation at 6.20%, we are significantly above our upper tolerance limit. A 50 bps hike is the minimum required to signal our commitment to price stability and prevent the unanchoring of inflation expectations. The positive output gap of 0.40% and the systemic liquidity surplus of 190,000 crore INR provide the necessary cushion for this front-loaded action. I cannot support a 25 bps hike, as it would be insufficient to address the persistent inflationary pressures and could ultimately necessitate more aggressive, disruptive actions later. My position remains firm on 50 bps to ensure a durable return to the 4% target.
